summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a Form 6-K disclosing periodic transactions under its ongoing share repurchase programme, announced on 6 May 2026, with a total authorized amount of DKK 15 billion over 12 months from 4 February 2026. The filing details weekly B-share buybacks (195,000 shares daily at average prices ~DKK 320-327) and accumulated progress (9,225,000 shares for ~DKK 2.73 billion). The programme is an ordinary open-market repurchase, not a tender offer, and does not constitute a special situation. The registrant is the issuer conducting routine capital return under Danish safe harbour rules.
